mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.child_id, c.name AS category_name, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r JOIN T_TDP_REQCTGR_R rc ON r.id = rc.today_permission_id JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON rc.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE r.parent_id = #{parentId} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT r.id, r.child_id, c.name AS category_name, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r JOIN T_TDP_REQCTGR_R rc ON r.id = rc.today_permission_id JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON rc.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE r.child_id = #{childId} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
